# Cardly

> Free tweet to image generator and social card maker.

Cardly turns X (Twitter) posts and plain text into clean, downloadable social card images directly in the browser.

- Convert X (Twitter) posts into clean retina PNG images.
- Customizable backgrounds, aspect ratios, and padding.
- No watermark, no signup needed.
- Export at 2x resolution for crisp, retina-quality PNGs.
- Works from plain text or a live x.com / twitter.com URL.
